descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · S17 Retention by context × item × age: 3.6/3.7 windows ±1 h, NH persistence and last two visits

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U7a Hospital: pre-round text and Important Points clear at 12 h (UAT TC-21 step 4; UAT 3.6; TFA-94699 (table)) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress; TFA-94699 in progress
  • U7b Hospital: the encounter dictation and the note leave the working tabs at 18 h and stay as yesterday's transcript / previous note until 36 h. … (UAT TC-21 step 4; UAT 3.6; TFA-94699 (table)) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress; TFA-94699 in progress
  • U7c Hospital: completed tasks clear at 16 h; open tasks clear 36 h after the chart was last processed (UAT TC-21 step 4; UAT 3.6; TFA-94699 (table)) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress; TFA-94699 in progress
  • U7d Hospital: vitals, labs, imaging and diagnostic tests clear 36 h after they were last refreshed. Each shows the date it was recorded, and lab trends show as in the prototype ('Cr 1.4, ↑ from 1.1'). … (UAT TC-21 step 4; UAT 3.6; UAT 3.7; UAT 3.4; TFA-94699 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress; TFA-94699 in progress
  • U7e Hospital: active medication rows show 'not mentioned today' from 18 h; all rows (active, held, stopped) clear at 36 h; held rows are refreshed each time the chart is processed (UAT TC-21 step 4; UAT 3.6; TFA-94699 (table)) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress; TFA-94699 in progress
  • U7f Hospital: handoffs clear 36 h after they are sent. This is in the ticket only, not in UAT 3.6 (Q1). (TFA-94699 (table)) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress; TFA-94699 in progress
  • U7g Nursing Home: pre-round 12 h, encounter 12 h, note 18 h. These are in UAT 3.6 only, not in TFA-94699's NH line (Q1). (UAT TC-21 step 4; UAT 3.6) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress; TFA-94699 in progress
  • U7h Nursing Home: notes, transcripts and medication events keep the last two visits (UAT TC-21 step 4; UAT 3.6; UAT 3.7; TFA-94699 (NH line); TFA-92599 AC 12) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress; TFA-94699 in progress
  • U7i Nursing Home: the chronic medication list and open tasks persist until changed (no 36 h purge) (UAT TC-21 step 4; UAT 3.6; TFA-94699 (NH line); UAT TC-07; UAT TC-13) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress; TFA-94699 in progress
  • U1f Vitals/meds cadence changes per context. Hospital refreshes daily with 36 h windows; Nursing Home works per visit and the chronic list persists. What 'correct' means is not written down (Q7). (UAT TC-21 step 1; UAT 3.6; UAT 3.7) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • T4 Retention deletes are real (the item queries as gone). 'Last refreshed' means a new value was recorded, so saving without one does not reset the clock. … (TFA-94699 AC 1; TFA-94699 AC 2; TFA-94699 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given Hospital chart and NH resident with one of each item, all timestamps controlled by an aging helper; NH resident with chronic meds, an open task and visits 1–2 completed

When Age each item to the cell's age and query the chart on the server; for NH also complete visit 3

Then Every cell matches. Key cells: 'NH open task at 37 h → still present' and 'NH chronic med at 37 h → still present' (the Hospital purge must not run for residents).

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT 3.6 / 3.7 per cell, plus TFA-94699 for handoffs (Q1), AC 1 (real deletion: a backend read shows the item gone), AC 2 and AC 5. Pre-labelled from code reading on e02167f (confirm in the aged run before relying on it): see knownGaps. The 3.7 parts that run today are elsewhere: recorded date on each panel value and lab trend (TC-13 S14; …

Where it ran: local manual (time lane, a script does the person's steps); test method TIME · Time / aging (clock moved); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S17 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-21.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; to be decided by Daniela; the Allure status was changed by the triage from failed to broken.

Issue type: Ticket not ready for QA · environment local · tickets TFA-92599 in progress; TFA-94699 in progress

Retention does not follow UAT 3.6/3.7 yet: Hospital Important Points and yesterday's encounter stay past their windows, the note disappears at 18 h instead of staying as the previous note, and Nursing Home keeps three visits instead of two.

Evidence: allure-results/627b207a…: 48/56 cells pass. All 8 fails are gated (TFA-92599 / TFA-94699 in progress): Hospital Important Points kept at 13 h (main uses 18 h); the note is deleted at 18 h instead of kept as the previous note until 36 h; yesterday's encounter is still listed at 37 h (48 h archive); open tasks are still there at 37 h; NH keeps visit 1 after visit 3 (main keeps 3 visits). These are TC-21 S17 knownGaps. The 48 h archive and the 3 NH visits are the deliberate-design item in dev report §3 for Daniela. The handoff cell is not run.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane manual.

Test method: TIME · Time / aging (clock moved); secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: manual.

New local lane manual: status failed in manual/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

How it is tested (manual/plan.json, automatable: partly): api spec. One Hospital chart and one NH resident per age cell, aged with aging.ts; server read before lifecycle, lifecycle, read again; cells as in the matrix spec.cells. Deleted-row cell: delete a med row / task / IP through rounding:update, then a real pre-round Save Note (UI) that does not name them, read. Handoff cell: recorded as not run (needs server-stamped sentAt and a second account). Positive control after each Save Note: notesProcessedAt moved and preRoundError empty (aging.ts lastSave.proof), saved in the evidence; the silent-save cells count only when it passes. — All stamp cells run; the handoff cell needs a sent handoff with a server-stamped sentAt and a recipient account (not built); NH visit-3 cell done with page.clock as TC-19/S13.

Detail:

48/56 judged cells pass (4 of them not discriminating on main), 2 NOT RUN. Fail: H Important Point 13 h cleared [U7a; gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress; TFA-94699 in progress] | H encounter 37 h gone [U7b; gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress; TFA-94699 in progress] | H note 19 h previous note [U7b; gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress; TFA-94699 in progress] | H note 35 h still previous [U7b; gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress; TFA-94699 in progress] | H open task 37 h after last processing cleared [U7c; gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress; TFA-94699 in progress] | NH after visit 3: visit-1 transcript gone, visits 2 and 3 kept [U7h; gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress; TFA-94699 in progress] | NH after visit 3: visit-1 note gone, visits 2 and 3 kept [U7h; gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress; TFA-94699 in progress] | NH after visit 3: visit-1 medication event (Given) gone [U7h; gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress; TFA-94699 in progress]. Not run: H handoff 35 h / 37 h after sent (ticket only, Q1) (needs a sent handoff with a server-stamped sentAt and a recipient account (server-stamped-fields, seed-second-account: not built)) | Nursing Home Save & Extract half (kept to the Hospital Save & Extract to bound live calls; NH Save Note covers the visit write).

Product issue: Known (TFA-92599 / TFA-94699 in progress). Hospital: Important Points are still there at 13 h. The note is not kept as the previous note at 19 h or 35 h; it is deleted at 18 h. Yesterday's encounter is still listed at 37 h (48 h archive). Open tasks are still there at 37 h. Nursing Home, after visit 3: the visit-1 transcript, note and Given row are still kept (main keeps 3 visits). The deleted-items cells pass in both contexts.

During the run (runNote): Intermittent, not counted: in 4 Save Notes today (TC-20/S17 NH during the 14:4x overload; TC-21/S17 Hospital at 16:55; TC-11/S03 NH at 16:59 and 17:02 JST) the text was saved but the structured summary never arrived and no error was set within 90 s (preRoundProcessing stuck true, or no notesProcessedAt and no preRoundError); the retries were clean. No aiCallLog row was captured for those attempts, so the cause (model latency vs app) is open; worth watching on dev.

Evidence: 7 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Needs the aging helper (a test-only internal mutation called with the local stack's admin key) and admin-key reads of internal tables (backend-read-admin); dev has no admin key, so it stays on the local stack (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
